items.why: AMD fell with the chip sector as Nvidia kept sliding and the Nasdaq dropped, though the major averages are still up for the week.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Nvidia keeps sliding after CEO Jensen Huang's exit, with reports calling the drop a crisis for the market's golden goose.
Meta rose as stocks set to bounce back from the Nvidia turmoil after futures jumped on the PPI report.

market_note: Futures are mixed, with S&P futures nearly flat and Nasdaq futures down 0.39%, while the 10-year yield is up 1.16% to 5.16%.
summary: Stocks were mixed early Friday, with the Nasdaq sliding as Nvidia kept falling while the Dow edged up after the PPI report. AMD and Bitcoin led the declines.
